node: AI software, automation, data platforms, and cloud revenue quality
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI software/data-workflow node finds one high-attention reference leader, one large-cap observability platform, and two smaller direct-exposure candidates. The chokepoint is not generic model access; it is governed enterprise deployment: data readiness, LLM observability, workflow orchestration, safety/evaluation, and auditability. Revenue-quality diligence remains critical because AI software claims can be easier to overstate than physical infrastructure bottlenecks.
